facts.architecture: Qwen3.8: 64 layers, of which 16 attend fully (the rest are linear-attention layers with a recurrent state); an MTP head

template.source: Qwen's reference chat template, as design 0012 §4.2 reads it: earlier thinking rendered only after the last user message, tool calls as XML; the template inside the model file is still to read (design 0012 §10)

files.notes: IQ3_S (GSQ-RCO) with the MTP head embedded

The vision projector "daily 262K" reads images with; no longer at the head of its repository, so its revision is not known and Clank does not download it: a user who has this exact file (its sha256 above) places it on the host, else runs the preset with its vision off

kvmem-llamacpp.source: KVMem v0.16.0-rc1's log on this model (model buffer 11,159.69 MiB, recurrent state 163.20 MiB, compute 374.28 MiB; the MTP head's pool 53,248 cells of 4,096 bytes, 208 MiB, at f16) and the prototype's measurement of 2026-10-06 (1,169 MiB beyond the weights and the KV cache, the buffers and the MTP head's pool included, leaving 424 MiB of overhead); the compute buffers took 594.28 MiB at 98,304 cells on 2026-10-18 ("frontier 96K", which took 14,453 MiB in all), so they are 114 MiB plus 5,120 bytes a cell, and buffers_mib holds the recurrent state and that 114
